notes: Step 1 parts were correct; no parts added or dropped.
Potentiometer is a 10k pot standing in for the 'analog sensor'; the circuit image and schematic show a potentiometer.

Pot legs go in neighbouring holes of one row (columns 11, 12, 13, row e) in the card's order GND, SIG, VCC. The image draws the wiper leg towards the other half of the board, but a pot's legs sit in one row, so the yellow wire shares the wiper's column strip (12t.d) to make the connection.
Breadboard bank naming follows the catalogue: bank 't' is rows a-e, which is the lower half in the image.
Black wire goes from Uno GND (GND.1 used) to pot leg 11 (GND end). Red wire goes from Uno 5V to pot leg 13 (VCC end). Yellow wire goes from A0 to the wiper (middle leg), matching the schematic.
The USB cable to the computer is not drawn in the circuit image, so it is not modelled.
